text: Objective: Through one semester study, students could have the ability of listening, reading, speaking and writing with Chinese in a short time. Characteristic: intensive & small size; Students who have learnt Chinese language before can choose the study duration and starting date according to their needs. The tuition for each month is RMB 2400 Courses: Chinese Pronunciation, Chinsese Vocabulary, Chinese Grammar, Chinese Reading, Chinese Writing, Chinese Listening, Oral Chinese, Chinese Communication, Presentation Techniques, Newspaper Reading, Chinese Lexicology, Practical Business Chinese, Chinese Introduction, Modern Chinese etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.
